layouts.name: Portland International Raceway
layouts.description: Draft identification from a uniquely connected OSM course with a matching layout name. Private reference start/finish GPS supports the venue association. Named source geometry and configuration still require visual review.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap course and venue identity
sources.evidenceNote: Venue identity and trace coordinates come from the pinned OSM extract. The source identity identifies the facility; course configuration is provisional. No privately sourced coordinates enter the public database.

sources.title: Aerial imagery for estimated road borders
sources.evidenceNote: Derived edge coordinates. Reusable imagery evidence: https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/usgs-eros-archive-aerial-photography-national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip. Image hashes, extents and extraction evidence are stored in the layout. Estimates remain unreviewed.
